alias.label: Device alias
alias.description: Name other LocalSend devices see when this machine sends.

nu_path.label: nushell path
nu_path.description: nu that runs localsend.nu (the protocol client).

socat_path.label: socat path
socat_path.description: socat used for UDP multicast discovery.

curl_path.label: curl path
curl_path.description: curl used for the upload requests.

ripdrag_path.label: ripdrag path
ripdrag_path.description: ripdrag provides the drag-and-drop target window.

zenity_path.label: zenity path
zenity_path.description: zenity provides the file and folder picker dialogs.

discover_ms.label: Discovery window (ms)
discover_ms.description: How long to listen for device replies after announcing.

clear_after_send.label: Clear after sending
clear_after_send.description: Empty the staged file list once a transfer completes.

download_dir.label: Download folder
download_dir.description: Where received files are saved. Existing names get a (1) suffix, never overwritten.

auto_accept_pinned.label: Auto-accept pinned devices
auto_accept_pinned.description: Devices starred in the panel are accepted without asking.

python_path.label: python3 path
python_path.description: python3 that runs receiver.py (the receiving server).
